name: sign-language-mcp
description: MCP server for querying sign language descriptions across Auslan, JSL, and International Sign

tools.name: list_available_words
tools.description: Get a list of all words that have sign language descriptions available. Use this first to discover what words can be looked up.

tools.name: list_available_languages
tools.description: Get a list of all supported sign languages (Auslan, JSL, International Sign)

tools.name: get_sign_description
tools.description: Get the sign language description for a specific word. Returns descriptions for all languages unless a specific language is specified.
